name: Univa Foods Limited
summary: Univa Foods Limited currently maintains a minimal operational footprint. Historically, the enterprise was active in the hospitality sector, offering catering services, manufacturing and vending confectioneries and savory items, and managing dining establishments. Originally incorporated in 1991 and based in Mumbai, India, the company was formerly known as Hotel Rugby Limited until its rebranding to Univa Foods Limited in August 2022.
